HEADLINE: Pursuant to Regulation 30, 33 and other applicable provisions of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, (the "Listing ....

Pursuant to Regulation 30, 33 and other applicable provisions of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, (the "Listing Regulations"), We hereby inform you that the Board of Directors at its meeting held today i.e., Saturday, October 24, 2026, has, inter alia, approved and taken on record the Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the Quarter and Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.

We are enclosing herewith Standalone & Consolidated Un-audited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year Ended September 30, 2026, Cash Flow Statements, Statement of Assets & Liabilities, as approved by the Board of Directors together with the Auditor's Limited Review Reports thereon.
